name: Nahawa Core Lite
author: sadiosan23

sections.description:
Nahawa Core Lite helps users launch a Nahawa-powered WordPress site without a license key or account.

Included functionality:

  • Guided Nahawa onboarding.
  • Corporate Lite Starter Site.
  • Shop Lite Starter Site for WooCommerce.
  • Safe re-import behavior for demo content created by Nahawa.
  • Beginner-friendly documentation.
  • Local System Status screen.

Everything shipped inside Nahawa Core Lite is available without a payment gate, time limit, quota or remote license check. Premium functionality is not embedded in this plugin.

Nahawa Core Lite does not transmit analytics or advertising telemetry and does not require an external service. Optional Discover Pro links open the Nahawa commercial website only after an administrator explicitly clicks them.

Privacy

Nahawa Core Lite performs no automatic remote requests, telemetry, tracking, advertising calls, license checks or private update checks.

The optional commercial links in the plugin administration open https://nahawa-platform.techsol.sn only after an administrator chooses to click them. No site data is sent by the plugin before that action.

Bundled Assets and Licensing

All code, Starter Site content, SVG illustrations, preview images and demo product images bundled with Nahawa Core Lite are distributed under the same GPLv2-or-later license as the plugin. The plugin contains no third-party JavaScript or PHP libraries and loads no remote fonts, scripts, stylesheets or images.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the free Nahawa theme.
  2. Install and activate Nahawa Core Lite.
  3. Open Nahawa in the WordPress admin.
  4. Choose a free Starter Site or begin directly in Appearance > Editor.
  5. For Shop Lite, install and activate WooCommerce before importing the demo.
sections.faq:
Do I need a license key?

No. Every feature included in Nahawa Core Lite is free to use.

Does the plugin contact a licensing server?

No. Nahawa Core Lite contains no license activation or remote update client.

Does the plugin send analytics or telemetry?

No. Nahawa Core Lite does not automatically send usage, site or administrator data to Nahawa or another external service.

What happens when I click a Discover Pro link?

Your browser opens https://nahawa-platform.techsol.sn only after you explicitly click the link. The plugin does not contact that website in the background.

Will importing a Starter Site overwrite my existing pages?

The importer avoids overwriting unrelated pages. When a requested slug is already owned by other content, Nahawa creates a collision-safe slug for its demo page.

Is WooCommerce required?

Only Shop Lite requires WooCommerce. Corporate Lite does not.

Can I later use the commercial Nahawa Core Pro add-on?

Yes. Core Pro is a separately distributed add-on and can reuse the Starter Site import metadata created by Lite. Deactivate Core Lite before using Core Pro.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Removed the unexpected LICENSES.md file from the production package to satisfy WordPress.org Plugin Check.
  • Kept bundled asset licensing information in the standard readme.txt section instead of a custom root Markdown file.

1.0.5

  • Updated the WordPress.org Contributors field to the plugin owner’s username, sadiosan23.
  • Removed the automatic post-activation redirect and replaced it with a non-intrusive plugin-row dashboard link.
  • Hardened Starter Site imports with stronger definition validation and a preflight check before content changes are made.
  • Replaced direct local file reads and copies with the WordPress filesystem API.
  • Sanitized generated Starter Site URLs before inserting them into imported content.
  • Strengthened WooCommerce demo product validation and allowed image types.
  • Added explicit privacy and bundled-asset licensing documentation for WordPress.org review.
  • Removed historical release-document files from the distribution package to keep the plugin focused on runtime files.

1.0.4

  • Replaced direct unlink() cleanup with the WordPress wp_delete_file() API.
  • Removed manual load_plugin_textdomain() loading because WordPress.org language packs are loaded automatically.
  • Reworked Starter Site import feedback to use per-user transients instead of unverified query-string parameters.
  • Added the required Tested up to metadata for WordPress.org.

1.0.3

  • Fixed unreadable success/error notices in the Nahawa Core Lite admin screens.
  • Reformatted Starter Site HTML and admin CSS for readable, maintainable source code.
  • Improved compatibility with the Nahawa Theme guided Core Lite onboarding.

1.0.2

  • Redesigned Corporate Lite and Shop Lite Starter Sites with richer page layouts, modern hero sections, metrics, testimonials, CTAs and subtle animations.
  • Added local demo illustrations and Shop Lite product imagery with no external asset dependency.
  • Improved free Starter Site preview cards and product presentation while preserving a clear upgrade path to Nahawa Pro.

1.0.1

  • Added a discreet Discover Pro admin page and dashboard card linking to https://nahawa-platform.techsol.sn.
  • Added a clear Free vs Pro comparison without embedding or remotely unlocking paid code in Core Lite.
  • Core Lite performs no automatic license or analytics requests; commercial links open only when the administrator chooses them.

1.0.0

  • First public release.
  • Added Corporate Lite and Shop Lite Starter Sites.
  • Added beginner onboarding and documentation.
  • Added local system status.
  • No license gates, trials, quotas or remote service dependency.
